ctx.x: Hell yes! I worked with so many Black guys that I didn't know what it was like... When I played with White guys, I felt out of place, hah-hah-hah-hah, because I was always playing with the Black guys or playing for a Black singer. And I didn't give a damn. I was happy.

No, but I was thinking of the Central Avenue scene when you first hit here, that was just around the time when the War started and all that. And I guess the audience in those clubs was mixed. Or was it mostly a Black audience?
